en: Black‑and‑white vintage view of a European city street and square. In the foreground stands a large baroque fountain with multiple statues in a circular basin. Behind it are multi‑story buildings with arcades at street level and shuttered windows above. A broad street extends into the distance, lined with historic buildings; horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians are visible. On the right is a domed church or chapel. In the top‑right corner, red text reads "Trento Via Rodolfo Belenzani."
